# `nlink-lab test`

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Run topology tests: deploy, validate, destroy

Usage: nlink-lab test [OPTIONS] <PATH>

Arguments:
  <PATH>
          Topology file or directory of .nll files

Options:
      --set <KEY=VALUE>
          Set a `param` value (repeatable) for every file: --set k=v

      --junit <JUNIT>
          Write JUnit XML results to file

      --tap
          Write TAP output to stdout

      --fail-fast
          Stop on first failure

      --scenarios
          Also run every `scenario` block of each topology after its `validate` assertions: each action is one more result

      --benchmarks
          Also run every `benchmark` block: each test is one more result

      --keep
          Leave a lab whose test failed deployed, for inspection (destroy it with `nlink-lab destroy LAB`)

      --seed <N>
          Deploy every lab with this seed, in place of its topology's `seed`: the seed a failed run reported replays its packet losses

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

<!-- cli-ref:end -->
